subject: URGENT: Production server down
body: Hi team, our main production server has been unresponsive for the last 15 minutes. Customer-facing services are impacted. We need all hands on deck immediately. Please join the incident bridge call ASAP.

subject: Updated PTO Policy for 2025
body: Dear employees, we've updated our paid time off policy effective February 1st. Key changes include an additional floating holiday and simplified rollover rules. Please review the attached document and reach out with questions.

subject: Congratulations! You've Won $1,000,000!
body: Dear Lucky Winner, you have been selected as the grand prize winner of our international lottery! To claim your $1,000,000 prize, please provide your bank account details and social security number. Act now before the offer expires!

subject: Contract renewal discussion
body: Hi, I wanted to follow up on our contract renewal. Our current agreement expires on February 28th and we'd like to discuss terms for a 2-year extension. Could you send over the updated pricing proposal by end of this week? We have a board meeting on Monday where I'll need to present options.

subject: CRITICAL: Security breach detected
body: Our intrusion detection system has flagged unauthorized access attempts on the customer database. We've isolated the affected segments but need your team to review access logs immediately and rotate all API keys. This is a P0 incident.

subject: This Week in AI: Top 10 Trends for 2025
body: Welcome to our weekly roundup! This week we cover the latest developments in AI agents, multimodal models, and open-source LLMs. Plus, a deep dive into how companies are adopting RAG architectures. Click below to read more.

subject: Code review needed: Auth service refactor
body: Hey, I've submitted PR #428 for the authentication service refactor we discussed. It touches about 15 files and changes how we handle JWT token refresh. Would really appreciate your review before the sprint ends tomorrow. No rush today but please take a look by EOD tomorrow.

subject: FLASH SALE: 90% OFF Designer Watches!!!
body: INCREDIBLE DEALS you won't find anywhere else! Genuine designer watches at 90% off retail price. Limited stock available. Order now and receive FREE shipping worldwide! Visit our website immediately. Unsubscribe link at bottom.

subject: Board meeting prep — need your input
body: Hi, the quarterly board meeting is next Thursday. I need each department head to send me a 1-page summary of Q4 results and Q1 outlook by Wednesday. Please include key metrics, major wins, and any risks we should discuss. Let me know if you have questions.

subject: JIRA-7823: Customer unable to export reports
body: A high-priority customer (Enterprise tier) has reported they cannot export reports in CSV format since yesterday's deployment. This is blocking their monthly compliance reporting. The customer has escalated through their account manager. Please investigate and provide an ETA for resolution.

subject: Company picnic this Saturday!
body: Join us for our annual company picnic at Riverside Park this Saturday from 11 AM to 4 PM! We'll have BBQ, games, and activities for the whole family. RSVP by Thursday so we can plan catering. See you there!

subject: Action Required: Verify Your Bank Account
body: Dear Valued Customer, we have detected suspicious activity on your account. Please click the link below to verify your identity within 24 hours or your account will be permanently suspended. This is an automated security measure.

subject: Invoice #INV-2025-0042 attached
body: Hi, please find attached invoice #INV-2025-0042 for January cloud hosting services totaling $4,250. Payment is due within 30 days. Let me know if you have any questions about the line items or need any adjustments.

subject: Scheduled maintenance window tonight
body: Reminder: we have a scheduled maintenance window tonight from 11 PM to 3 AM EST. The staging environment will be unavailable during this time. Production should not be affected. Please plan your work accordingly.

subject: Make $5000/week Working From Home!!!
body: Amazing opportunity! No experience needed! Make $5000 or more per week working from the comfort of your own home. Thousands of people have already joined our program. Send your personal details to get started TODAY. Limited spots available!
